title: Kissed Smoky Slovakian Dates Skewers
description: A charred and bouncy Slovakian dish featuring pitted dates, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is satvik-friendly and smoke-hot.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Thread 2-3 pitted dates onto each skewer.
Brush the dates with olive oil and sprinkle with the smoked paprika mixture.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until charred.
Brush the dates with lemon juice during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the heat and let cool for a minute or two.
Serve the Kissed Smoky Slovakian Dates Skewers warm or at room temperature.
